<script lang="ts">
  import { Button, CommandPalette } from '@larose-ui/svelte';
  let open = $state(true);
  const items = [
    { id: 'new', label: 'New file', group: 'File', onSelect: () => (open = false) },
    { id: 'save', label: 'Save', group: 'File', onSelect: () => (open = false) },
  ];
</script>

<Button onclick={() => (open = true)}>Open commands</Button>
